title: Answer on an action turn
description: The model's answer on an ACT turn: exactly one JSON object of one form, and nothing else (CONTRACT.md v0.6 §7.1, §7.2, §16.3). Every field of the form is present and no other; rationale is optional. Text around the object or a code fence fails before this schema is reached. spark_open gives the same object as one answer-tool call, which its adapter converts (§11.1). The model never writes request_id, origin, utc, met_s, nonce, run_id, turn_id, plan_id, agent_input_hash or signature (§7.3).

rationale.description: One or two sentences (§7.1). Prose goes here.

command.description: Becomes a signed COMMAND_REQUEST to BALDUR-0.

escalation.description: Becomes an ESCALATION in the log and on the console, through POST /escalation. It asks nothing of anyone in this build; it records ODIN's judgment.

refs.description: Strings naming the evidence: point mnemonics, request IDs, log record IDs, procedure steps (PROC-002 step 5) or plan fields. May be empty (§16.3 U11).

proposed.description: The command ODIN proposes, checked like any command, or null when it proposes none (§16.3 U11).
